description: Authenticate with your Misar.Blog account via browser — no API key copy-paste needed. Opens the Misar.Blog authorization page where you review the requested permissions and click 'Authorize'. Your API key is delivered straight back to this client and saved to ~/.misarblog/config.json.

base_url.description: Misar.Blog base URL for self-hosted instances.

force.description: Force re-authentication even if already logged in (rotates your API key).

port.description: Local callback port (9001–9099). Random by default.

name: login
title: Log in via browser
